passages.scene: A waiter helps a woman order for her family.

lines.en: Sure. Today our new dish is fish. Would you like to try it?

lines.zh: 好啊，来一条鱼，再来一碗米饭和两杯茶。
lines.en: OK, one fish, plus a bowl of rice and two cups of tea.

lines.zh: 还要别的吗？
lines.en: Do you need anything else?

lines.zh: 有甜的吗？孩子喜欢吃甜的。
lines.en: Do you have anything sweet? The child likes sweet things.

passages.title: Is there a bank nearby?

lines.zh: 请问，附近有银行吗？
lines.en: Excuse me, is there a bank nearby?

lines.zh: 有，你往前走，到第二个路口往右走。
lines.en: Yes. You go straight ahead and turn right at the second junction.

lines.zh: 是在红绿灯那儿吗？
lines.en: Is that where the traffic lights are?

lines.en: Yes. Once you have passed the traffic lights, the bank is right by the road, with a supermarket next to it.

lines.en: Did you bring your passport?

lines.zh: 带了，在我的包里。
lines.en: Yes, I brought it. It is in my bag.

lines.zh: 我们的飞机几点起飞？
lines.en: What time does our plane take off?

lines.zh: 飞机是十点的，但是我刚才听说晚点了，要十一点半才起飞。
lines.en: The flight is at ten, but I just heard it is late: it will only take off at half past eleven.

lines.zh: 还有两个多小时，我们先去吃饭吧。

passages.title: Seventy in maths
passages.scene: Two classmates talk about a maths exam.

lines.zh: 这次数学考试你考得怎么样？
lines.en: How was your result in this maths exam?

lines.zh: 不太好，我只考了七十分。
lines.en: Not very well. I only got 70.

lines.zh: 是不是题太难了？
lines.en: Were the questions too hard?

lines.zh: 题不难，是我没有认真复习。最近每天晚上都在玩游戏。
lines.en: They were not hard; I did not revise properly. Recently I have been playing games every evening.

lines.zh: 下次考试前，我们一起去图书馆复习吧。
lines.en: Before the next exam, let's revise together at the library.

lines.zh: 好啊，谢谢你。

passages.title: Wind and rain
passages.scene: A woman stops a man from cycling in bad weather.

lines.zh: 外面刮大风了，还在下雨。
lines.en: It is very windy outside, and it is raining.

lines.en: Really? Today I am going to cycle to work.

lines.zh: 别骑了，不安全。
lines.en: Do not ride any more; it is not safe.

lines.en: Then I will take the metro.

lines.en: I might have a fever, and my head hurts a lot too.

passages.title: Next year in China
passages.scene: A man asks a woman about her plans.

lines.zh: 你明年有什么打算？

passages.title: The new neighbour
passages.scene: A woman who has just moved in meets her neighbour.

lines.zh: 你好，我是新搬来的邻居，就住在你对面。
lines.en: Hello, I am the new neighbour who has just moved in. I live right across from you.

lines.zh: 欢迎欢迎！我在这儿住了三年了，有什么需要可以找我。
lines.en: Welcome! I have lived here for three years. If you need anything, you can come to me.

lines.zh: 谢谢！请问附近哪儿有超市？
lines.en: Thank you! Excuse me, where is there a supermarket nearby?

lines.zh: 出了小区往左走，大概五百米就有一个大超市，晚上十一点才关门。
lines.en: Leave the estate and turn left; about 500 metres on there is a big supermarket. It does not close until eleven at night.

lines.zh: 太好了。还有，垃圾我应该放在哪儿？
lines.en: Great. Also, where should I put the rubbish?

lines.zh: 楼下有四个垃圾桶，要按颜色放。
lines.en: There are four bins downstairs, and you have to sort it by colour.

lines.zh: 好的，我会注意的。以后有问题我再找你。
lines.en: OK, I will be careful about it. If I have a problem later, I will come to you again.

passages.title: After the interview
passages.scene: A woman asks a friend about his job interview.

lines.zh: 我听说你昨天去面试了，怎么样？
lines.en: I heard you had an interview yesterday. How did it go?

lines.zh: 还不错，经理问了我很多问题，我都回答得很流利。
lines.en: Not bad. The manager asked me a lot of questions, and I answered all of them fluently.

lines.zh: 那家公司的工资高吗？
lines.en: Is the pay at that company high?

lines.zh: 比我现在的工资高一千块，但是经常要加班。
lines.en: It is 1,000 yuan more than my pay now, but you often have to work overtime.

lines.zh: 加班有加班费吗？
lines.en: Is there overtime pay?

lines.zh: 有。他们说下个星期会通知我结果。
lines.en: Yes. They say they will let me know the result next week.

lines.zh: 祝你成功！
lines.en: I wish you success!

passages.title: Renting a flat
passages.scene: A man asks an agent about a flat for rent.

lines.zh: 这个房子一个月房租多少钱？
lines.en: How much is the rent for this flat a month?

lines.zh: 四千五百块，水电费不在房租里，要自己付。
lines.en: It is 4,500 yuan. Water and electricity are not in the rent; you need to pay them yourself.

lines.zh: 有点儿贵。厨房和客厅大吗？
lines.en: That is a bit expensive. Are the kitchen and living room big?

lines.zh: 客厅很大，厨房小一点儿，但是很干净，家具都是新的。
lines.en: The living room is big and the kitchen is a little smaller, but it is very clean, and all the furniture is new.

lines.zh: 离地铁站远吗？
lines.en: Is it far from the metro station?

lines.zh: 走路只要五分钟。
lines.en: It is only five minutes on foot.

lines.zh: 那我想先看看，明天下午可以吗？
lines.en: Then I would like to see it first. Is tomorrow afternoon OK?

lines.zh: 可以，我跟房东说一下。
lines.en: Sure, I will tell the landlord.

passages.title: Will I make my flight?
passages.scene: A woman in a taxi is worried about her flight.

lines.zh: 师傅，我要赶下午三点的航班，来得及吗？
lines.en: Driver, I need to catch a three o'clock flight this afternoon. Is there enough time?

lines.zh: 现在一点半，路上如果不堵车，我们一个小时就能到。
lines.en: It is half past one now. If there is no traffic jam, we can get there in an hour.

lines.zh: 可是现在路上车挺多的。
lines.en: But there are quite a lot of cars on the road now.

lines.zh: 别着急，我走高速，高速上车少。
lines.en: Do not worry. I will take the motorway; there are fewer cars on it.

lines.zh: 太感谢了。如果错过了这个航班，我今天就不能回家了。
lines.en: Thank you so much. If I miss this flight, I will not be able to go home today.

lines.zh: 放心吧，一定来得及。
lines.en: Relax, there is definitely enough time.

passages.title: Bought online
passages.scene: A man asks a woman about her new coat.

lines.zh: 你这件外套真好看，在哪儿买的？
lines.en: Your coat looks really nice. Where did you buy it?

lines.zh: 我是在网上买的，那时候在打折，只花了三百块。
lines.en: I bought it online. It was being sold at a discount then, so I only spent 300 yuan.

lines.zh: 这么便宜！质量怎么样？
lines.en: That cheap! What is the quality like?

lines.zh: 还可以。但是在网上买，有时候也会买到质量不好的东西。
lines.en: It is OK. But when you buy online, sometimes you also get things whose quality is not good.

lines.zh: 对，我上次买的鞋，穿了一个星期就破了。
lines.en: True. The shoes I bought last time fell apart after a week.

lines.zh: 所以买之前要先看看别人怎么说。
lines.en: So before you buy, you should first look at what other people say.

passages.title: After the check-up
passages.scene: A woman asks a friend why he stopped going to the gym.

lines.zh: 你最近怎么不去健身房了？
lines.en: Why have you stopped going to the gym recently?

lines.zh: 我工作压力太大，每天都加班，没有时间。
lines.en: Work is too stressful. I work overtime every day and have no time.

lines.zh: 上个月体检的结果怎么样？
lines.en: What were the results of last month's check-up?

lines.zh: 医生说我的体重增加了五公斤，要多运动，少吃油多的东西。
lines.en: The doctor said my weight has gone up by five kilos, and that I should exercise more and eat less oily food.

lines.zh: 那你每天下班以后去散步吧，半个小时也好。
lines.en: Then you should go for a walk every day after work; even half an hour is good.

lines.zh: 好，我从今天开始。

lines.en: Sorry, I was just about to let you know: the meeting has been put back to next Wednesday.

lines.en: And the time? Is it still nine in the morning?

passages.scene: A woman sees a man buy a bag at the supermarket again.

lines.en: Why have you bought a bag at the supermarket again?

lines.en: This kind of bag is used once and thrown away. It is so wasteful, and it is not good for the environment either.

passages.title: The forest in the snow
passages.scene: Two friends plan a weekend trip.

lines.en: Hello. I just took a taxi, and I left my wallet in the car.

lines.zh: 别着急。您还记得是几点上车、在哪儿下车的吗？
lines.en: Don't worry. Do you remember what time you got in and where you got out?

lines.zh: 大概下午三点在火车站上的车，二十分钟以后在医院门口下的车。
lines.en: I got in at the railway station at about three in the afternoon, and twenty minutes later I got out at the gate of the hospital.

lines.zh: 您还记得车的号码吗？
lines.en: Do you remember the number of the car?

lines.zh: 我没注意号码，只记得司机是个年轻人，车是绿色的。
lines.en: I did not notice the number. I only remember that the driver was a young man and the car was green.

lines.zh: 钱包是什么颜色的？里面有什么？
lines.en: What colour is the wallet? What is in it?

lines.zh: 黑色的，里面有我的身份证、两张银行卡和五百多块钱。
lines.en: It is black. My ID card, two bank cards and a bit over 500 yuan are in it.

lines.zh: 好的，我马上联系那个时间在火车站附近的司机，有消息就给您打电话。
lines.en: All right. I will contact the drivers who were near the railway station at that time right away, and call you as soon as there is news.

lines.zh: 太感谢了！您打这个电话就能找到我。
lines.en: Thank you so much! You can reach me on this number.

qs.zh: 男的把什么忘在车上了？
qs.en: What did the man leave in the car?
Where did the man get into the taxi?

qs.zh: 关于那辆车，男的记得什么？
qs.en: What does the man remember about the car?
How much money is in the wallet?
What will the woman do next?

passages.title: A cooking class
passages.scene: A woman tells a friend about her cooking class.

lines.zh: 听说你最近在学做菜？
lines.en: I hear you have been learning to cook lately?

lines.zh: 对，我参加了一个周末的做菜班，每个星期六上午上课。
lines.en: Yes, I joined a weekend cooking class. There is a class every Saturday morning.

lines.zh: 要花多少钱？贵不贵？
lines.en: How much does it cost? Is it expensive?

lines.zh: 一共八次课，一千二百块，材料都是老师准备的。
lines.en: There are eight classes in all, for 1,200 yuan, and the teacher prepares all the ingredients.

lines.zh: 那还不错。你都学会做什么了？
lines.en: That is not bad. What have you learned to make?

lines.zh: 上次学了做西红柿鸡蛋汤，这次学包饺子。
lines.en: Last time we learned to make tomato and egg soup, and this time we are learning to make dumplings.

lines.zh: 包饺子很难吧？
lines.en: Making dumplings must be hard?

lines.zh: 一开始我包得很难看，后来老师教了我一个好办法，现在好多了。
lines.en: At first mine looked ugly, but then the teacher taught me a good way to do it, and now they are much better.

lines.zh: 下次你包了饺子，一定要请我尝尝。
lines.en: Next time you make dumplings, you must let me try some.

lines.zh: 没问题，这个周末就请你来我家吃。
lines.en: No problem. I invite you to my place to have some this weekend.

qs.en: When does the woman have her class?
How many classes are there in all?
Who prepares the ingredients?
What is the woman learning to make this time?

qs.zh: 女的请男的什么时候来吃饺子？
qs.en: When does the woman invite the man to come and eat dumplings?

passages.title: New library hours
passages.scene: A teacher tells students about changes at the library.

lines.zh: 同学们，大家好。从下个星期一开始，图书馆的开门时间有一些变化。
lines.en: Hello, everyone. From next Monday, the library's opening times will change a little.

lines.zh: 星期一到星期五，早上八点开门，晚上十点关门，比以前晚关一个小时。
lines.en: From Monday to Friday it opens at eight in the morning and closes at ten at night, an hour later than before.

lines.zh: 周末只开半天，从早上九点到下午一点。
lines.en: At the weekend it is only open for half a day, from nine in the morning to one in the afternoon.

lines.zh: 另外，三楼正在修理，这个月不能进去。
lines.en: Also, the third floor is being repaired, so you cannot go in there this month.

lines.zh: 需要安静学习的同学，可以去二楼。
lines.en: Students who need to study somewhere quiet can go to the second floor.

lines.zh: 借书的规定没有改变，每个人最多可以借五本，时间是一个月。
lines.en: The rules for borrowing books have not changed: each person can borrow at most five books, for one month.

lines.zh: 如果到时间了还没看完，可以在网上再借一个月。
lines.en: If you have not finished a book when the time is up, you can borrow it for another month online.

lines.zh: 谢谢大家的理解。
lines.en: Thank you all for your understanding.

qs.zh: 图书馆的开门时间从什么时候开始变化？
qs.en: From when do the library's opening times change?

qs.zh: 星期一到星期五图书馆几点关门？
qs.en: What time does the library close from Monday to Friday?

qs.zh: 周末图书馆什么时候开门？
qs.en: When is the library open at the weekend?

qs.zh: 为什么这个月不能去三楼？
qs.en: Why can't students go to the third floor this month?

qs.zh: 书到时间了还没看完，可以怎么办？
qs.en: What can you do if the time is up and you have not finished a book?

passages.title: A present for Mum
passages.scene: A woman asks a friend what to give her mother.

lines.zh: 下个星期是我妈妈的生日，我还没想好送她什么。
lines.en: Next week is my mum's birthday, and I still have not decided what to give her.

lines.zh: 去年你送了什么？
lines.en: What did you give her last year?

lines.zh: 去年送了一条裙子，可是她觉得颜色太亮了，一次也没穿过。
lines.en: Last year I gave her a skirt, but she thought the colour was too bright and never wore it once.

lines.zh: 那这次送一些有用的吧，比如一个新手机？
lines.en: Then give her something useful this time, like a new phone?

lines.zh: 她的手机刚换不久，而且她不喜欢用太复杂的东西。
lines.en: She changed her phone not long ago, and she does not like using things that are too complicated.

lines.zh: 你妈妈平时有什么爱好？
lines.en: What does your mum like doing in her free time?

lines.zh: 她特别喜欢种花，家里到处都是她种的花。
lines.en: She really loves growing flowers. There are flowers she has grown all over the house.

lines.zh: 那送她几本关于种花的书，或者周末带她去公园看花。
lines.en: Then give her some books about growing flowers, or take her to the park to see the flowers at the weekend.

lines.zh: 好主意！我还可以请她在外面吃顿饭。
lines.en: Good idea! I can also take her out for a meal.

lines.zh: 我觉得她会很高兴的。礼物不一定要贵，最重要的是你用了心。
lines.en: I think she will be very happy. A present does not have to be expensive; what matters most is that you put your heart into it.

qs.en: Whose birthday is it next week?

qs.zh: 妈妈为什么没穿去年的裙子？
qs.en: Why didn't her mum wear last year's skirt?

qs.zh: 女的为什么不想送手机？
qs.en: Why doesn't the woman want to give a phone?
What does the woman's mum like doing?

qs.zh: 男的觉得送礼物什么最重要？
qs.en: What does the man think matters most in a present?

passages.title: A bad cough
passages.scene: A man sees a doctor about his cough.

lines.zh: 大夫，我这两天一直咳嗽，晚上也睡不好。
lines.en: Doctor, I have been coughing for the past two days, and I can't sleep well at night.

lines.zh: 发烧吗？
lines.en: Do you have a fever?

lines.zh: 昨天晚上开始有点儿发烧，今天早上好一点儿了。
lines.en: I started to have a bit of a fever last night. This morning it was a little better.

lines.zh: 吃东西的时候疼不疼？
lines.en: Does it hurt when you eat?

lines.zh: 有一点儿疼，特别是吃辣的东西的时候。
lines.en: It hurts a little, especially when I eat something spicy.

lines.zh: 问题不大，是感冒了。最近天气变化大，很多人都感冒了。
lines.en: It is nothing serious; you have a cold. The weather has been changing a lot lately, and many people have caught colds.

lines.zh: 需要打针吗？
lines.en: Do I need an injection?

lines.zh: 不用，我给你开一些药，一天三次，饭后吃。
lines.en: No. I will give you some medicine: three times a day, after meals.

lines.zh: 我明天还要去上班，可以吗？
lines.en: I have to go to work tomorrow. Is that all right?

lines.zh: 最好在家休息两天，多喝水，别喝酒。
lines.en: You had better rest at home for two days, drink lots of water and don't drink alcohol.

qs.en: Where does the man not feel well?

qs.zh: 男的什么时候开始发烧的？
qs.en: When did the man start to have a fever?
What does the doctor say is wrong with the man?
How should the medicine be taken?
What does the doctor advise the man to do?

passages.title: The train is late
passages.scene: Two passengers wait for a delayed train.

lines.zh: 请问，你也是坐九点二十的那趟火车吗？
lines.en: Excuse me, are you also taking the 9:20 train?

lines.zh: 是的，可是刚才广播说火车要晚到四十分钟。
lines.en: Yes, but the announcement just said the train will be 40 minutes late.

lines.zh: 怎么又晚了？我上个月坐的时候也晚了半个小时。
lines.en: Late again? When I took it last month it was half an hour late too.

lines.zh: 听说是因为前面下大雪，火车开得比较慢。
lines.en: I heard it is because of heavy snow up ahead, so the trains are going more slowly.

lines.zh: 这下麻烦了，我十一点还要参加一个重要的会议。
lines.en: Now that is a problem. I have an important meeting at eleven.

lines.zh: 那你最好先给同事打个电话，说明一下情况。
lines.en: Then you had better call your colleagues first and explain the situation.

lines.zh: 对，我现在就打。你要去哪儿？
lines.en: Right, I will call now. Where are you going?

lines.zh: 我回家看父母，晚一点儿没关系。
lines.en: I am going home to see my parents, so being a bit late does not matter.

lines.zh: 那边比这儿冷多了吧？
lines.en: It must be much colder there than here?

lines.zh: 对，我带了很厚的衣服，也给父母买了些水果。
lines.en: Yes. I have brought thick clothes, and I bought some fruit for my parents.

qs.en: How late will the train be?
Why will the train be late?
What does the man have to do at eleven?

passages.title: Should we get a dog?
passages.scene: A couple talk about their son wanting a dog.

lines.zh: 儿子一直想养一只小狗，你觉得怎么样？
lines.en: Our son keeps saying he wants a puppy. What do you think?

lines.zh: 养狗可不是一件简单的事，每天都要带它出去散步。
lines.en: Keeping a dog is not a simple thing. You have to take it out for a walk every day.

lines.zh: 儿子说他会负责，每天放学以后带它出去。
lines.en: Our son says he will be responsible and take it out every day after school.

lines.zh: 他现在说得好听，过几个星期可能就忘了。
lines.en: He says that now, but in a few weeks he might forget.

lines.zh: 那我们先跟他说好，如果他做不到，就不能玩手机。
lines.en: Then we will agree with him first: if he does not do it, he cannot play on his phone.

lines.zh: 还有，咱们家太小了，狗在家里跑来跑去，邻居会不会不高兴？
lines.en: Also, our flat is too small. If a dog runs around inside, won't the neighbours be unhappy?

lines.zh: 可以养一只小一点儿的，而且楼下的邻居也养了一只，从来没人说过什么。
lines.en: We can get a smaller one. Besides, the neighbours downstairs have one too, and no one has ever said anything.

lines.zh: 好吧，那这个周末我们带他去看看。
lines.en: All right, then we will take him to have a look this weekend.

lines.zh: 太好了，他听了一定会高兴得跳起来。
lines.en: Great. He will be so happy he will jump for joy when he hears.

qs.en: Who wants a dog?

qs.zh: 男的说养狗每天都要做什么？
qs.en: What does the man say you have to do every day with a dog?

qs.zh: 儿子说什么时候带狗出去？
qs.en: When does the son say he will take the dog out?
What is the man worried about?

qs.zh: 他们打算什么时候带儿子去看狗？
qs.en: When do they plan to take their son to look at dogs?

passages.title: First day at work
passages.scene: A manager shows a new colleague around.

lines.zh: 你好，你就是新来的同事吧？我姓高，是你的经理。
lines.en: Hello, you must be our new colleague? My surname is Gao, and I am your manager.

lines.zh: 高经理好！今天是我第一天上班，有很多不懂的地方。
lines.en: Hello, Manager Gao! Today is my first day at work, and there is a lot I do not know yet.

lines.zh: 别紧张，我先带你看看。这是你的座位，电脑已经准备好了。
lines.en: Don't be nervous. Let me show you around first. This is your seat, and your computer is ready.

lines.zh: 谢谢。请问我们几点上班，几点下班？
lines.en: Thank you. What time do we start and finish work?

lines.zh: 早上九点到下午六点，中午十二点到一点吃饭和休息。
lines.en: From nine in the morning to six in the afternoon, with lunch and a break from twelve to one.

lines.zh: 公司里有吃饭的地方吗？
lines.en: Is there somewhere to eat in the company?

lines.zh: 有，在一楼，饭菜又便宜又好吃。另外，每周一上午十点开会，别忘了。
lines.en: Yes, on the ground floor, and the food is cheap and good. Also, there is a meeting every Monday at ten in the morning, so don't forget.

lines.zh: 好的。我的工作主要是什么？
lines.en: OK. What will my work mainly be?

lines.zh: 这个月你先跟着小张学习，熟悉一下公司的情况。
lines.en: This month you should first learn from Xiao Zhang and get familiar with the company.

lines.zh: 明白了，我会努力的。
lines.en: I understand. I will work hard.

qs.en: Who is the man?
What time does work finish?
Where is the place to eat?

qs.zh: 每周一上午十点要做什么？
qs.en: What happens every Monday at ten in the morning?

qs.zh: 这个月女的主要做什么？
qs.en: What will the woman mainly do this month?

passages.title: Rain on Saturday
passages.scene: Two friends change their weekend plans.

lines.zh: 听说星期六有大雨，我们去爬山的计划怎么办？
lines.en: I heard there will be heavy rain on Saturday. What about our plan to go hiking?

lines.zh: 那我们改到星期天吧？
lines.en: Then shall we change it to Sunday?

lines.zh: 星期天也不行，下午还有小雨，山上的路会很不好走。
lines.en: Sunday is no good either. There will be light rain in the afternoon, and the paths on the mountain will be hard to walk on.

lines.zh: 那就别去爬山了，我们在城里找些别的事做。
lines.en: Then let's not go hiking. We will find something else to do in the city.

lines.zh: 新开的那个动物园怎么样？听说里面有很多有意思的动物。
lines.en: How about the new zoo? I hear there are lots of interesting animals there.

lines.zh: 我上个月去过了，不过可以再去一次。
lines.en: I went last month, but I could go again.

lines.zh: 你去过了啊？那我们去看电影吧，最近有个新电影大家都说不错。
lines.en: Oh, you have been? Then let's see a film. There is a new one everyone says is good.

lines.zh: 好啊，看完电影还可以去吃饺子，下雨天吃些热的东西最舒服了。
lines.en: Sure. After the film we can go and have dumplings. On a rainy day, eating something hot feels best.

lines.zh: 那就这么定了，我去网上买票。
lines.en: Then it is settled. I will buy the tickets online.

lines.zh: 买晚上的吧，我上午要去机场接我妹妹。
lines.en: Get evening tickets. I have to pick up my younger sister at the airport in the morning.

qs.zh: 他们本来打算星期六做什么？
qs.en: What had they planned to do on Saturday?

qs.zh: 为什么星期天也不能去？
qs.en: Why can't they go on Sunday either?
Where did the man go last month?

qs.zh: 看完电影他们打算做什么？
qs.en: What do they plan to do after the film?
What does the man have to do in the morning?

passages.title: How I learned Chinese
passages.scene: A student from abroad talks about learning Chinese.

lines.zh: 我是三年前来中国留学的，刚来的时候，我只会说“你好”和“谢谢”。
lines.en: I came to China to study three years ago. When I first arrived, I could only say "hello" and "thank you".

lines.zh: 第一个月最难，买东西、坐公共汽车，什么都要别人帮忙。
lines.en: The first month was the hardest. Buying things, taking the bus: I needed help with everything.

lines.zh: 后来我发现，学语言最好的办法就是多说，不要怕说错。
lines.en: Later I found that the best way to learn a language is to speak a lot and not be afraid of making mistakes.

lines.zh: 我每天去学校旁边的小饭馆吃饭，跟那儿的服务员聊天。
lines.en: Every day I eat at the little restaurant next to the school and chat with the waiter there.

lines.zh: 他说话很快，开始我只能听懂一点儿，现在差不多都能听懂了。
lines.en: He speaks very fast. At first I could only understand a little, but now I can understand almost everything.

lines.zh: 汉字对我来说是最难的，我每天晚上都要写半个小时。
lines.en: Chinese characters are the hardest for me. I write them for half an hour every evening.

lines.zh: 现在我已经能看懂一些简单的中文报纸了，明年打算在这儿找工作。
lines.en: Now I can already read some simple Chinese newspapers, and next year I plan to find a job here.

lines.zh: 我觉得，只要坚持，学好汉语并不像大家想的那么难。
lines.en: I think that as long as you keep at it, learning Chinese well is not as hard as people think.

qs.zh: 男的是什么时候来中国的？
qs.en: When did the man come to China?

qs.zh: 男的觉得学语言最好的办法是什么？

passages.title: At the bank
passages.scene: A student opens a bank account.

lines.zh: 你好，我想办一张银行卡。
lines.en: Hello, I would like to get a bank card.

lines.zh: 好的，请问您带护照了吗？
lines.en: Certainly. Did you bring your passport?

lines.zh: 带了，给你。办卡要多长时间？
lines.en: Yes, here you are. How long does it take to get a card?

lines.zh: 大概十五分钟。请先在这张表上写上您的名字、电话和地址。
lines.en: About fifteen minutes. Please first write your name, phone number and address on this form.

lines.zh: 地址写学校的可以吗？我还没租到房子。
lines.en: Can I write the school's address? I have not found a flat to rent yet.

lines.zh: 可以。另外，您还要想一个六位的密码。
lines.en: Yes. You will also need to think of a six-digit password.

lines.zh: 好的。办好以后，可以在手机上用吗？
lines.en: OK. Once it is done, can I use it on my phone?

lines.zh: 可以，手机上也能用，很方便。
lines.en: Yes, you can use it on your phone too. It is very convenient.

lines.zh: 如果卡丢了，怎么办？
lines.en: What should I do if I lose the card?

lines.zh: 马上给我们打电话，这个号码二十四小时都有人接。
lines.en: Call us right away. Someone answers this number 24 hours a day.

qs.en: Why has the woman come to the bank?
How long does it take to get a card?

qs.en: Why does the woman write the school's address?

passages.title: The sports competition
passages.scene: A teacher tells her class about a school sports competition.

lines.zh: 同学们，下个星期五学校有体育比赛，现在我说一下要注意的事情。
lines.en: Everyone, there is a school sports competition next Friday. Now I will tell you what you need to know.

lines.zh: 比赛早上八点开始，大家七点半以前要到学校。
lines.en: It starts at eight in the morning, and everyone must be at school before half past seven.

lines.zh: 每个人最多可以参加两项比赛。
lines.en: Each person can take part in at most two events.

lines.zh: 想参加的同学，这个星期三以前把名字告诉我。
lines.en: If you want to take part, tell me your name before this Wednesday.

lines.zh: 那天请大家穿运动鞋，带上水和帽子，因为天气可能会很热。
lines.en: On the day, please wear trainers and bring water and a hat, because it may be very hot.

lines.zh: 如果下雨，比赛就改到下个星期一。
lines.en: If it rains, the competition will move to the following Monday.

lines.zh: 比赛不是最重要的，希望大家玩得开心，也要注意安全。
lines.en: Winning is not the most important thing. I hope you all have fun, and remember to be careful.

lines.zh: 还有什么问题，可以下课以后来办公室找我。
lines.en: If you have any other questions, come and find me in the office after class.

qs.en: When is the sports competition?

qs.zh: 大家几点以前要到学校？
qs.en: By what time must everyone be at school?

qs.zh: 每个人最多可以参加几项比赛？
qs.en: How many events can each person take part in at most?

qs.zh: 想参加比赛的同学什么时候以前要告诉老师？
qs.en: By when must students who want to take part tell the teacher?
What will happen if it rains?

passages.title: Grandpa's mornings
passages.scene: A woman talks about her grandfather.

lines.zh: 我爷爷今年七十五岁了，已经退休十五年了。
lines.en: My grandpa is 75 this year and has already been retired for 15 years.

lines.zh: 他每天早上六点起床，先去公园散步，然后回家练书法。
lines.en: He gets up at six every morning, first goes for a walk in the park, and then comes home to practise calligraphy.

lines.zh: 他说练书法能让人心里平静。
lines.en: He says practising calligraphy can make people feel calm inside.

lines.zh: 周末的时候，我们全家都会回去陪伴他。
lines.en: At weekends our whole family will go back to keep him company.

lines.zh: 爷爷说，他最希望全家人都身体健康。
lines.en: Grandpa says what he hopes for most is for the whole family to be healthy.

qs.en: How many years has Grandpa been retired?

qs.zh: 爷爷每天早上先做什么？
qs.en: What does Grandpa do first every morning?

qs.zh: 爷爷觉得练书法有什么好处？
qs.en: What does Grandpa think is good about practising calligraphy?
What will the whole family do at weekends?
What does Grandpa hope for most?

passages.title: Hotpot tonight
passages.scene: A couple decide what to have for dinner.

lines.zh: 今天晚上咱们吃什么？
lines.en: What shall we have tonight?

lines.zh: 天气这么冷，吃火锅吧。
lines.en: It is so cold, let's have hotpot.

lines.zh: 好主意。咱们家里有什么？
lines.en: Good idea. What do we have at home?

lines.zh: 冰箱里有豆腐、土豆和一些蔬菜，不过没有肉了。
lines.en: There is tofu, potatoes and some vegetables in the fridge, but no meat left.

lines.zh: 那我去楼下的便利店买一些牛肉和羊肉。
lines.en: Then I will go to the convenience store downstairs and buy some beef and lamb.

lines.zh: 顺便买一些饮料，再买一些面条。火锅最后煮面条最好吃了。
lines.en: Get some drinks while you are there, and some noodles too. Noodles cooked in the hotpot at the end taste the best.

lines.zh: 行，我十分钟就回来。
lines.en: OK, I will be back in ten minutes.

qs.en: What are they having tonight?
Why does the woman want to have this?
What is there no more of in the fridge?
Where does the man go to buy things?

qs.zh: 女的让男的顺便买什么？
qs.en: What does the woman ask the man to buy on the way?

passages.title: A flat of my own
passages.scene: A man talks to an agent about renting a flat.

lines.zh: 我想租一套公寓，一个人住。
lines.en: I would like to rent a flat to live in by myself.

lines.zh: 您每个月的租金最多能接受多少？
lines.en: What is the most you can accept for the rent each month?

lines.zh: 最好不超过五千。
lines.en: Ideally not more than 5,000.

lines.zh: 这套离地铁站很近，面积不大，可是刚刚装修过，家具和家电都是新的。
lines.en: This one is very close to the metro station. It is not big, but it has just been redecorated, and the furniture and appliances are all new.

lines.zh: 租金四千八百块。
lines.en: The rent is 4,800 yuan.

lines.zh: 押金我要付多少？
lines.en: How much do I need to pay as a deposit?

lines.zh: 押金是一个月的租金。如果没问题，我们明天就可以签合同。
lines.en: The deposit is one month's rent. If there is no problem, we can sign the contract tomorrow.

qs.en: What does the man want to rent?

qs.zh: 男的希望租金最多是多少？
qs.en: What is the most the man hopes to pay in rent?
What is special about this flat?

qs.zh: 这套公寓的租金是多少？
qs.en: How much is the rent for this flat?
How much is the deposit?

passages.title: Fifth birthday sale
passages.scene: An announcement in a shop.

lines.zh: 各位顾客，欢迎光临。
lines.en: Dear customers, welcome.

lines.zh: 为了庆祝本店开业五周年，从今天到这个星期日，所有商品都打折，原来一百块的，现在只要八十块。
lines.en: To celebrate our shop's fifth anniversary, from today until this Sunday, everything is on sale: what used to cost 100 yuan now costs only 80.

lines.zh: 会员每买一百块，还可以再少付十块。
lines.en: Members can also pay 10 yuan less for every 100 yuan they spend.

lines.zh: 另外，购物满五百元，就赠送一个漂亮的杯子。
lines.en: In addition, if you spend 500 yuan, you will get a pretty cup as a gift.

lines.zh: 活动期间，每天营业到晚上十点。祝您购物愉快！
lines.en: During the sale, the shop is open until ten every evening. Wishing you happy shopping!

qs.en: Why is the shop holding this sale?
When does the sale end?

qs.zh: 会员可以享受什么优惠？
qs.en: What extra offer can members get?
opts: 每买一百块再少付十块

qs.en: How much do you need to spend to get a cup?

qs.zh: 活动期间每天营业到几点？
qs.en: Until what time is the shop open each day during the sale?

passages.title: An accident on the way
passages.scene: A woman explains why she is late.

lines.zh: 你怎么这么晚才到？
lines.en: Why are you so late?

lines.zh: 别提了，前面发生了一起车祸，我在路上堵了一个多小时。
lines.en: Do not ask. There was a car accident ahead, and I was stuck on the road for over an hour.

lines.zh: 严重吗？有人受伤吗？
lines.en: Was it serious? Was anyone hurt?

lines.zh: 不太严重，两辆车撞在一起，司机都没事。
lines.en: Not very serious. Two cars hit each other, and both drivers are fine.

lines.zh: 交警说其中一辆车超速了。
lines.en: The traffic police said one of the cars was speeding.

lines.zh: 超速很危险，肯定要罚款吧？
lines.en: Speeding is dangerous. There must be a fine?

lines.zh: 我听说司机不仅要罚款，还可能有一段时间不能开车了。
lines.en: I heard the driver will not only have to pay a fine, but may also not be allowed to drive for a while.

qs.en: Why is the woman late?
opts: 路上发生了车祸，堵车了

qs.en: How long was the road blocked?
Was the accident serious?

qs.en: What did the traffic police say caused the accident?

qs.zh: 超速的司机可能会怎么样？
qs.en: What may happen to the speeding driver?
opts: 被罚款，还可能一段时间不能开车

passages.title: Forgot the password
passages.scene: A man helps a woman with an app.

lines.zh: 我想在这个软件上买火车票，可是注册不了。
lines.en: I want to buy train tickets in this app, but I cannot register.

lines.zh: 屏幕上显示什么？
lines.en: What does the screen show?

lines.zh: 它说我的手机号码已经注册过了。
lines.en: It says my phone number has already been registered.

lines.zh: 你是不是以前用过这个软件？你可以用手机号码登录试试。
lines.en: Did you use this app before? You can try logging in with your phone number.

lines.zh: 可是我忘记密码了。
lines.en: But I have forgotten the password.

lines.zh: 没关系，点“忘记密码”，它会给你的手机发一条短信，里面有几个数字，输入以后就能设置新密码。
lines.en: No problem. Tap "forgot password", and it will send a text message to your phone with a few numbers in it. After you type them in, you can set a new password.

lines.zh: 好了，我登录成功了！
lines.en: There, I have logged in!

qs.zh: 女的想在软件上做什么？
qs.en: What does the woman want to do in the app?
Why can the woman not register?
opts: 她的手机号码已经注册过了

qs.en: What does the man tell the woman to do?

qs.zh: 女的后来遇到了什么问题？
qs.en: What problem did the woman run into next?
What happened in the end?

passages.title: Leaving the job
passages.scene: A man asks a friend why she quit her job.

lines.zh: 我听说你辞职了？
lines.en: I heard you quit your job?

lines.zh: 对，我在那家公司实习了一年，后来又工作了两年，可是待遇一直没有提高。
lines.en: Yes. I was an intern at that company for a year and then worked there for two more years, but the pay and conditions never got better.

lines.zh: 那你接下来打算做什么？
lines.en: So what do you plan to do next?

lines.zh: 我已经投了几份简历，有一家科技公司约我下周面试。
lines.en: I have already sent out a few CVs, and a tech company has asked me to an interview next week.

lines.zh: 科技公司的发展前途不错。
lines.en: Tech companies have good prospects.

lines.zh: 是啊，而且离我家很近，不用每天挤地铁了。
lines.en: Yes, and it is very close to my home, so I will not have to squeeze onto the metro every day.

qs.zh: 女的在原来的公司一共待了几年？
qs.en: How many years in total was the woman at her old company?
Why did the woman quit?
Which company has asked the woman to an interview?
When is the woman's interview?
What is good about the new company?

passages.title: Noisy neighbours
passages.scene: A woman tells a friend about her sleepless nights.

lines.zh: 楼上的邻居每天晚上都很吵，我已经好几天睡不好了。
lines.en: The neighbours upstairs are noisy every night, and I have not slept well for days.

lines.zh: 你跟他们沟通过吗？
lines.en: Have you talked it over with them?

lines.zh: 我上个星期去过一次，他们说家里有孩子，没办法。
lines.en: I went once last week. They said they have children at home and cannot help it.

lines.zh: 那你可以给物业打电话，让物业跟他们说。
lines.en: Then you could call the property management and get them to talk to the neighbours.

lines.zh: 我打过了，物业说会解决，可是到现在一点儿变化都没有。
lines.en: I did. The property management said they would sort it out, but so far nothing has changed at all.

lines.zh: 那你可以晚上戴着耳机听音乐。
lines.en: Then you could wear headphones and listen to music at night.

lines.zh: 我只能先这样了。
lines.en: I can only leave it like that for now.

qs.en: Why can the woman not sleep well?

qs.zh: 女的去找邻居的时候，邻居怎么说？
qs.en: What did the neighbours say when the woman went to see them?
Who does the man suggest the woman contact?
What happened after the property management promised to act?

qs.zh: 男的最后建议女的做什么？
qs.en: What does the man suggest at the end?

passages.title: Sleep well
passages.scene: A doctor gives advice on a radio programme.

lines.zh: 很多年轻人习惯熬夜，晚上玩手机玩到一两点。
lines.en: Many young people are used to staying up late, playing on their phones until one or two at night.

lines.zh: 时间长了，就容易失眠，第二天也没有精神。
lines.en: Over time it is easy to get insomnia, and the next day you have no energy.

lines.zh: 一般来说，成年人每天最好睡七到八个小时。
lines.en: Generally speaking, it is best for adults to sleep seven to eight hours a day.

lines.zh: 睡觉前一个小时最好不要看手机，可以看看书或者听听轻松的音乐。
lines.en: It is best not to look at your phone in the hour before bed; you could read or listen to some relaxing music.

lines.zh: 另外，晚饭不要吃得太饱，也不要喝咖啡和浓茶。
lines.en: Also, do not eat too much at dinner, and do not drink coffee or strong tea.

qs.zh: 很多年轻人有什么习惯？
qs.en: What habit do many young people have?

qs.zh: 熬夜时间长了会怎么样？
qs.en: What can happen if you stay up late for a long time?

qs.zh: 成年人每天最好睡多久？
qs.en: How long is it best for adults to sleep each day?

qs.zh: 睡觉前一个小时最好不要做什么？
qs.en: What is it best not to do in the hour before bed?
How should you eat at dinner?

passages.title: Visiting the elderly
passages.scene: A man tells a friend about his weekend plans.

lines.zh: 这个周末你有什么安排？
lines.en: What are your plans for this weekend?

lines.zh: 我报名参加了社区的志愿者活动，去看望附近的老人。
lines.en: I have signed up for a community volunteer activity: visiting the elderly people nearby.

lines.zh: 你们去了要做什么？
lines.en: What will you do when you get there?

lines.zh: 帮他们打扫卫生，陪他们聊天儿，还教他们用智能手机。
lines.en: Help them clean, keep them company and chat, and also teach them to use smartphones.

lines.zh: 听起来很有意义。下次能带我一起去吗？
lines.en: That sounds really worthwhile. Can you take me with you next time?

lines.zh: 当然可以，下个月还有一次，我提前告诉你。
lines.en: Of course. There is another one next month; I will tell you in advance.

qs.zh: 男的这个周末要做什么？
qs.en: What will the man do this weekend?
Who are they visiting?
What will they teach the elderly people to do?
What does the woman want to do?

qs.zh: 下一次活动是什么时候？
qs.en: When is the next activity?

passages.title: Welcome to the museum
passages.scene: A guide speaks to a tour group.

lines.zh: 各位游客，大家好，欢迎来到本市的历史博物馆。
lines.en: Hello, everyone, and welcome to the city's history museum.

lines.zh: 我们这个城市已经有两千多年的历史了。
lines.en: Our city already has a history of over 2,000 years.

lines.zh: 一楼展出的是古代人用过的工具和生活用品。
lines.en: On the first floor are tools and everyday things that people used in ancient times.

lines.zh: 二楼是书法和国画展览，很多作品都非常珍贵。
lines.en: The second floor has an exhibition of calligraphy and Chinese painting; many of the works are very precious.

lines.zh: 参观的时候请不要拍照，也不要用手摸这些东西。
lines.en: During the visit, please do not take photos, and do not touch these things with your hands.

lines.zh: 参观结束以后，可以在一楼的商店买一些小礼物。
lines.en: After the visit, you can buy some small gifts in the shop on the first floor.

qs.zh: 这个城市有多少年的历史？
qs.en: How long is this city's history?
What is on the first floor?
opts: 古代人用过的工具和生活用品

qs.en: What exhibition is on the second floor?

qs.zh: 参观的时候不能做什么？
qs.en: What may you not do during the visit?
Where can you buy small gifts?

passages.title: To go or not to go
passages.scene: A man is unsure whether to take a job far away.

lines.zh: 我在犹豫要不要去南方工作。
lines.en: I am hesitating over whether or not I want to go and work in the south.

lines.zh: 那边的工资不是比这边高很多吗？
lines.en: Is the pay there not much higher than here?

lines.zh: 是高不少，可是我父母年纪大了，我不想离他们太远。
lines.en: It is quite a lot higher, but my parents are getting old, and I do not want to be too far from them.

lines.zh: 坐高铁回来也就四个多小时，周末也能回家。
lines.en: It is only a little over four hours back by high-speed train, so you could come home at weekends.

lines.zh: 你说得对，可是工作一忙，我说不定一个月都回不了一次。
lines.en: You are right, but once work gets busy, I might not even get back once a month.

lines.zh: 反正还有时间考虑，你跟父母商量一下再决定吧。毕竟这是你自己的事。
lines.en: Anyway, there is still time to think it over. Talk to your parents and then decide. After all, it is your own decision.

qs.en: What is the man hesitating over?
What is the pay like in the south?
Why is the man hesitating?
opts: 父母年纪大了，他不想离他们太远

qs.en: How long does the high-speed train take to get back?
What does the woman suggest the man do?
opts: 跟父母商量一下再决定

passages.title: A café of my own
passages.scene: A man tells a friend he wants to open a café.

lines.zh: 我最近一直在考虑辞职，自己开一家咖啡店。
lines.en: Lately I have been thinking about quitting my job and opening a café of my own.

lines.zh: 开店可不容易，你算过要花多少钱吗？
lines.en: Opening a shop is not easy. Have you worked out how much it will cost?

lines.zh: 算过了，房租再加上买机器和别的东西，至少需要三十万。
lines.en: I have. Rent, plus buying the machines and other things: at least 300,000 yuan.

lines.zh: 这么多！钱从哪儿来？
lines.en: That much! Where will the money come from?

lines.zh: 我自己存了十五万，剩下的打算跟一个朋友合作，他出另一半。
lines.en: I have saved 150,000 myself. For the rest I plan to go into it with a friend, and he will put in the other half.

lines.zh: 合作的话，最好先把每个人负责什么说清楚，不然以后容易产生矛盾。
lines.en: If you work together, you had better make clear first what each person is in charge of, or it is easy to fall out later.

lines.zh: 你说得对。我们已经商量好了，他负责管钱，我负责做咖啡和管理店里的事。
lines.en: You are right. We have already agreed: he will look after the money, and I will make the coffee and run the shop.

lines.zh: 地方选好了吗？开咖啡店最重要的是位置。
lines.en: Have you chosen a place? For a café, the location matters most.

lines.zh: 看了几个，我比较满意的是大学附近的一个，学生多，房租也不算太贵。
lines.en: I have looked at a few. The one I like best is near a university: there are lots of students, and the rent is not too high.

lines.zh: 听起来不错。不过辞职之前，最好先在周末去别人的店里打工，积累一点儿经验。
lines.en: Sounds good. But before you quit, you had better work weekends in someone else's café first and get some experience.

qs.en: What is the man planning to do?
How much does opening the shop need at least?
What will his friend be in charge of?

qs.zh: 男的比较满意的地方在哪儿？
qs.en: Where is the place the man likes best?

qs.zh: 女的建议男的辞职前先做什么？
qs.en: What does the woman suggest the man do before quitting?

passages.title: New rules for rubbish
passages.scene: A notice to everyone living on an estate.

lines.zh: 各位邻居，大家好。为了保护环境，从下个月一号开始，我们小区要开始用新的垃圾分类办法。
lines.en: Hello, neighbours. To protect the environment, from the first of next month our estate will start a new way of sorting rubbish.

lines.zh: 以后垃圾要分四种放：吃剩的饭菜，纸和瓶子，旧电池，还有其他垃圾。
lines.en: From now on, rubbish must be sorted into four kinds: leftover food; paper and bottles; old batteries; and everything else.

lines.zh: 每座楼下面都会放四个不同颜色的垃圾桶，上面写着放什么。
lines.en: There will be four bins of different colours under every building, each marked with what goes in it.

lines.zh: 扔垃圾的时间也有了变化：早上七点到九点，晚上六点到八点。
lines.en: The times for putting out rubbish have changed too: seven to nine in the morning, and six to eight in the evening.

lines.zh: 其他时间垃圾桶会被收起来，请大家不要把垃圾放在楼下。
lines.en: At other times the bins will be taken away, so please do not leave rubbish downstairs.

lines.zh: 刚开始大家可能不太习惯，所以第一个月会有人在旁边帮大家。
lines.en: At first you may not be used to it, so for the first month there will be someone standing by to help.

lines.zh: 如果分错了，第一次只是提醒，不会罚款。
lines.en: If you sort something wrongly, the first time you will only get a reminder, not a fine.

lines.zh: 另外，旧衣服可以放到小区门口的绿色箱子里，会送给需要的人。
lines.en: Also, old clothes can go in the green box at the gate of the estate. They will be given to people who need them.

lines.zh: 有什么不明白的地方，欢迎打电话问我们。
lines.en: If there is anything you don't understand, you are welcome to call and ask us.

qs.en: When does the new way of sorting start?
How many kinds must rubbish be sorted into?

qs.zh: 晚上什么时候可以扔垃圾？
qs.en: When can rubbish be put out in the evening?

qs.zh: 第一次分错了会怎么样？
qs.en: What happens the first time someone sorts wrongly?
Where should old clothes go?
opts: 小区门口的绿色箱子里

passages.title: Classes online
passages.scene: A radio host talks to a teacher about online classes.

lines.zh: 今天的节目我们来聊聊网上上课。张老师，您觉得网上上课有哪些好处？
lines.en: In today's programme we are talking about online classes. Teacher Zhang, what do you think are the good points of online classes?

lines.zh: 最大的好处是方便，学生在家就能上课，不用每天花很多时间在路上。
lines.en: The biggest one is convenience. Students can have class at home and do not have to spend a lot of time travelling every day.

lines.zh: 那缺点呢？
lines.en: And the drawbacks?

lines.zh: 主要是学生很难集中注意力，特别是年龄小的孩子，一会儿就去玩别的了。
lines.en: Mainly that students find it hard to concentrate, especially young children, who soon go off to play with something else.

lines.zh: 那老师可以怎么做呢？
lines.en: So what can teachers do?

lines.zh: 我的办法是每十分钟就让学生回答一个问题，或者分小组讨论，这样他们就会认真听了。
lines.en: What I do is have students answer a question every ten minutes, or discuss in small groups. That way they listen carefully.

lines.zh: 家长在这方面能帮上什么忙吗？
lines.en: Can parents help with this in any way?

lines.zh: 家长最好给孩子准备一个安静的地方，上课的时候把手机拿走。
lines.en: Parents should give their child a quiet place, and take the phone away during class.

lines.zh: 您觉得以后网上上课会代替学校吗？
lines.en: Do you think online classes will take the place of schools one day?

lines.zh: 我觉得不会。学校不只是学知识的地方，孩子还需要跟同学交朋友、一起活动。
lines.en: I don't think so. School is not only a place to learn things. Children also need to make friends with classmates and do things together.

qs.en: What does the man think is the biggest good point of online classes?

qs.zh: 网上上课的主要缺点是什么？
qs.en: What is the main drawback of online classes?

qs.zh: 男的每十分钟让学生做什么？
qs.en: What does the man have students do every ten minutes?
What does the man suggest parents do?
opts: 给孩子准备一个安静的地方

qs.zh: 男的为什么觉得网上上课不会代替学校？
qs.en: Why does the man think online classes will not take the place of schools?

passages.title: To buy a car or not
passages.scene: A man explains to a friend why he wants a car.

lines.zh: 你真的打算买车啊？
lines.en: You really plan to buy a car?

lines.zh: 是啊，每天坐地铁上班要换两次车，一次就要一个多小时，太累了。
lines.en: Yes. Going to work by underground every day means changing twice, and each trip takes over an hour. It is too tiring.

lines.zh: 可是开车也不一定快，早上路上车那么多。
lines.en: But driving is not necessarily faster, with so many cars on the road in the morning.

lines.zh: 我查过了，开车大概四十分钟，如果早一点儿出门，能节省不少时间。
lines.en: I checked. Driving takes about 40 minutes, and if I leave a bit earlier, I can save quite a lot of time.

lines.zh: 那钱呢？油钱、停车费、保险，一年下来可不少。
lines.en: What about money? Petrol, parking and insurance add up to quite a lot over a year.

lines.zh: 公司有免费的停车位，这样就能省下一大笔钱。
lines.en: My company has free parking spaces, so that saves a big sum.

lines.zh: 你想买哪种车？
lines.en: What kind of car do you want to buy?

lines.zh: 我想买一辆小一点儿的，好停车，也比较省油。
lines.en: I want a smaller one. It is easy to park and uses less petrol.

lines.zh: 买车是件大事，你别着急，周末我陪你一起去看看。
lines.en: Buying a car is a big decision. Don't rush. I will go and look with you at the weekend.

lines.zh: 太好了，你比我懂车，有你在我就放心了。
lines.en: Great. You know more about cars than I do, so with you there I feel at ease.

qs.en: Why does the man want to buy a car?

qs.zh: 开车上班大概要多长时间？
qs.en: About how long does it take to drive to work?

qs.zh: 为什么男的不用担心停车费？
qs.en: Why doesn't the man need to worry about parking?
What kind of car does the man want?
What will the woman do at the weekend?

passages.title: After the operation
passages.scene: A woman visits a colleague in hospital.

lines.zh: 听说你做手术了，现在感觉怎么样？
lines.en: I heard you had an operation. How are you feeling now?

lines.zh: 好多了，谢谢你来看我。手术很成功，医生说再过一个星期就能出院了。
lines.en: Much better, thank you for coming to see me. The operation went well, and the doctor says I can leave hospital in another week.

lines.zh: 那就好。我给你带了一些水果和汤，汤是我妈妈做的。
lines.en: Good. I brought you some fruit and soup. My mum made the soup.

lines.zh: 替我谢谢阿姨。医院的饭菜真没什么味道。
lines.en: Thank her for me. The hospital food really has no taste at all.

lines.zh: 公司的事你别担心，你负责的那个项目，经理让小马暂时帮你管着。
lines.en: Don't worry about work. The manager has asked Xiao Ma to look after your project for now.

lines.zh: 那太好了，我还一直担心会影响大家的工作。
lines.en: That is great. I kept worrying that I would hold up everyone's work.

lines.zh: 你现在最重要的是好好休息，别想工作的事了。
lines.en: The most important thing for you now is to rest properly. Stop thinking about work.

lines.zh: 医生也这么说。出院以后还要在家休息一个月，不能跑步、打球。
lines.en: The doctor says so too. After I leave hospital I have to rest at home for a month, with no running or ball games.

lines.zh: 一个月正好可以看看书，把你一直想看的那几本小说看完。
lines.en: A month is just right for reading. You can finish those novels you have always wanted to read.

lines.zh: 好主意，你下次来的时候帮我从家里带几本过来吧。
lines.en: Good idea. Next time you come, bring a few from my home for me.

qs.en: How is the man now?

qs.zh: 男的大概什么时候能出院？
qs.en: About when can the man leave hospital?
Who made the soup?

qs.zh: 男的负责的项目现在由谁管？
qs.en: Who is looking after the man's project now?

qs.zh: 出院以后男的不能做什么？
qs.en: What must the man not do after leaving hospital?

passages.title: A cup of tea
passages.scene: A woman at a teahouse talks to visitors about Chinese tea.

lines.zh: 欢迎大家来我们店里喝茶。今天我想跟大家简单介绍一下中国的茶。
lines.en: Welcome to our shop for some tea. Today I would like to tell you a little about Chinese tea.

lines.zh: 中国人喝茶已经有几千年的历史了，茶的种类也非常多。
lines.en: Chinese people have been drinking tea for thousands of years, and there are a great many kinds of tea.

lines.zh: 最常见的有绿茶、红茶和花茶。北方人比较喜欢花茶，南方人更爱喝绿茶。
lines.en: The most common are green tea, black tea and flower tea. People in the north prefer flower tea, while people in the south like green tea better.

lines.zh: 茶好不好喝，水的温度很重要。
lines.en: Whether tea tastes good depends a lot on the temperature of the water.

lines.zh: 比如绿茶，水不能太热，八十度左右最合适，水太热了，茶就会变苦。
lines.en: For green tea, for example, the water must not be too hot. About 80 degrees is best; if the water is too hot, the tea turns bitter.

lines.zh: 喝茶也要注意一些礼貌。给客人倒茶的时候，不能倒得太满，七分满就可以了。
lines.en: There are also some manners to keep in mind when drinking tea. When you pour tea for a guest, don't fill the cup too full: seven tenths full is enough.

lines.zh: 如果别人给你倒茶，你可以用手指轻轻敲两下桌子，表示感谢。
lines.en: If someone pours tea for you, you can tap the table lightly twice with your fingers to say thank you.

lines.zh: 好，下面请大家尝一尝我们准备的三种茶，看看你最喜欢哪一种。
lines.en: Now, please taste the three teas we have prepared and see which one you like best.

qs.zh: 中国人喝茶有多长时间的历史了？
qs.en: For how long have Chinese people been drinking tea?

qs.zh: 南方人更喜欢喝什么茶？
qs.en: Which tea do people in the south prefer?

qs.zh: 绿茶用多少度的水最合适？
qs.en: What water temperature is best for green tea?

qs.zh: 给客人倒茶应该倒多少？
qs.en: How much should you pour for a guest?

qs.zh: 别人给你倒茶的时候，可以怎么表示感谢？
qs.en: How can you say thank you when someone pours tea for you?
opts: 用手指轻轻敲两下桌子

passages.title: A year abroad
passages.scene: A student tells a friend about her exchange year.

lines.zh: 听说你下学期要去国外交换？
lines.en: I hear you are going abroad on an exchange next term?

lines.zh: 对，我半年前申请的，终于通过了。要在那边读一年。
lines.en: Yes. I applied half a year ago, and it has finally been approved. I will study there for a year.

lines.zh: 祝贺你！费用都是学校出吗？
lines.en: Congratulations to you! Does the university pay for everything?

lines.zh: 学费是学校出的，生活费要靠自己。我打算到那边以后找份工作。
lines.en: The university pays the fees, but I have to cover my living costs myself. I plan to find a job when I get there.

lines.zh: 语言没问题吧？
lines.en: The language is no problem, right?

lines.zh: 听和读还可以，说得不太流利，所以这几个月我每天都在练习口语。
lines.en: Listening and reading are OK, but I do not speak very fluently, so for the last few months I have been practising speaking every day.

lines.zh: 住的地方找好了吗？
lines.en: Have you found somewhere to live?

lines.zh: 学校有宿舍，不过要跟另外一个学生住一个房间，我还在考虑要不要自己在外面租房子。
lines.en: The university has dormitories, but I would share a room with another student. I am still thinking about whether to rent a place outside.

lines.zh: 我建议你先住宿舍，认识的人多，对练习语言也有好处。
lines.en: I suggest you live in the dormitory first. You will get to know more people, and it is good for practising the language too.

lines.zh: 有道理。我最担心的是不习惯那边的饭，听说那边的人很少吃米饭。
lines.en: That makes sense. What worries me most is not being used to the food there. I hear people there rarely eat rice.

qs.en: What will the woman do next term?

qs.zh: 女的要在国外读多长时间？
qs.en: How long will the woman study abroad?
Who pays the fees?

qs.zh: 这几个月女的每天在练习什么？
qs.en: What has the woman been practising every day these months?
What worries the woman most?

passages.title: A boy has lost his mother
passages.scene: An announcement in a shopping centre.

lines.zh: 各位顾客请注意。
lines.en: Attention, please, all shoppers.

lines.zh: 一位妈妈在三楼卖孩子衣服的商店附近找不到她五岁的儿子了。
lines.en: A mother cannot find her five-year-old son near the children's clothes shop on the third floor.

lines.zh: 孩子穿着一件红色的上衣和一条黑色的裤子，背着一个黄色的小书包。
lines.en: The boy is wearing a red top and black trousers, and he has a small yellow school bag on his back.

lines.zh: 他大概一米一高，短头发，戴着白色的帽子。
lines.en: He is about 1.1 metres tall, with short hair, and he is wearing a white hat.

lines.zh: 如果您看到了这个孩子，请尽快把他带到一楼的服务台，或者告诉附近的工作人员。
lines.en: If you see this child, please bring him to the service desk on the ground floor as soon as possible, or tell a member of staff nearby.

lines.zh: 孩子的妈妈正在服务台等着。
lines.en: The boy's mother is waiting at the service desk.

lines.zh: 另外提醒各位家长，商场里人很多，请照顾好自己的孩子。
lines.en: We would also like to remind all parents that the shopping centre is very busy, so please take good care of your children.

lines.zh: 谢谢大家的帮助。
lines.en: Thank you all for your help.

qs.en: How old is the child?

qs.zh: 孩子穿着什么颜色的上衣？
qs.en: What colour top is the child wearing?
What is the child wearing on his head?

qs.zh: 看到孩子应该把他带到哪儿？
qs.en: Where should you take the child if you see him?

qs.zh: 孩子的妈妈现在在哪儿？
qs.en: Where is the child's mother now?

passages.title: Nervous before the talk
passages.scene: A woman is worried about giving a talk at work.

lines.zh: 明天我就要在全公司面前做报告了，紧张得睡不着。
lines.en: Tomorrow I have to give a talk in front of the whole company. I am so nervous I can't sleep.

lines.zh: 你准备得怎么样了？
lines.en: How is your preparation going?

lines.zh: 内容都准备好了，可是我一站到大家面前，就容易忘记要说什么。
lines.en: What I will say is all ready, but as soon as I stand in front of people, I tend to forget what I want to say.

lines.zh: 我以前也这样。后来我发现，提前多练几遍很有用，最好对着镜子练。
lines.en: I used to be like that too. Later I found it really helps to practise a few times beforehand, ideally in front of a mirror.

lines.zh: 我已经练了好几遍了，还是没有信心。
lines.en: I have already practised many times, but I still don't feel confident.

lines.zh: 那你明天早一点儿到会议室，先熟悉一下环境，试试电脑。
lines.en: Then you should get to the meeting room early tomorrow, get used to the room first and try the computer.

lines.zh: 好主意。还有别的办法吗？
lines.en: Good idea. Anything else?

lines.zh: 讲的时候不要一直看电脑，多看看下面的同事，就当是跟朋友聊天。
lines.en: When you speak, don't keep looking at the computer. Look at your colleagues in front of you, and pretend you are chatting with friends.

lines.zh: 万一有人问我回答不了的问题，怎么办？
lines.en: What if someone asks me a question I have no answer to?

lines.zh: 那就说你需要查一下，结束以后再告诉他。没有人会因为这个笑你的。
lines.en: Then say you need to look it up and will tell him afterwards. Nobody will laugh at you for that.

qs.en: Why can't the woman sleep?
What is the woman worried about?
opts: 站在大家面前会忘记要说什么

qs.zh: 男的建议女的怎么练习？
qs.en: How does the man suggest the woman practise?

qs.zh: 男的为什么让女的早一点儿到会议室？
qs.en: Why does the man tell the woman to get to the meeting room early?

qs.zh: 遇到回答不了的问题，男的建议怎么做？
qs.en: What does the man suggest if she gets a question she has no answer to?
opts: 说需要查一下，结束以后再告诉他

passages.title: No hot water
passages.scene: A woman calls her landlord about the hot water.

lines.zh: 喂，您好，我家从昨天晚上开始就一直没有热水。
lines.en: Hello. There has been no hot water in my flat since last night.

lines.zh: 是不是没电了？你看看上面的灯亮不亮。
lines.en: Has the power gone off? You look and see whether the light on it is on.

lines.zh: 我看过了，灯是亮的，可是水一直是凉的。
lines.en: I have checked. The light is on, but the water stays cold.

lines.zh: 那可能是里面的东西坏了，那个机器用了快八年了。
lines.en: Then something inside may be broken. That machine is nearly eight years old.

lines.zh: 那您什么时候能找人来修？天这么冷，没有热水实在太不方便了。
lines.en: So when can you get someone to fix it? In this cold weather, having no hot water is really inconvenient.

lines.zh: 我下午就联系修理的师傅，不过他最早可能明天上午才能来。
lines.en: I will contact the repairman this afternoon, but the earliest he can come is probably tomorrow morning.

lines.zh: 明天上午我要上班，家里没人。
lines.en: I am at work tomorrow morning, so nobody will be home.

lines.zh: 要不这样，你把钥匙放在楼下的邻居家，我陪师傅一起去。
lines.en: How about this: leave your key with the neighbour downstairs, and I will go with the repairman.

lines.zh: 可以。如果修不好，能不能换个新的？
lines.en: All right. If it can't be fixed, can you replace it with a new one?

lines.zh: 修不好的话，我就直接买个新的，钱由我来出，你放心吧。
lines.en: If it does not get fixed, I will just buy a new one and pay for it myself. Don't you worry.

qs.en: What is the problem in the woman's flat?

qs.zh: 那个机器用了多长时间了？
qs.en: How long has the machine been in use?

qs.zh: 修理的师傅最早什么时候能来？
qs.en: When is the earliest the repairman can come?
Where will the woman leave her key?

qs.zh: 如果修不好，男的打算怎么办？
qs.en: What will the man do if it does not get fixed?

passages.title: Before the big race
passages.scene: A woman has hurt her foot while training for a race.

lines.zh: 你走路怎么这么慢？腿怎么了？
lines.en: Why are you walking so slowly? What happened to your leg?

lines.zh: 别提了，上周跑步的时候不小心把脚弄伤了。
lines.en: Don't ask. I hurt my foot by accident while running last week.

lines.zh: 你还在为下个月那场四十二公里的比赛做准备？
lines.en: Are you still getting ready for that 42-kilometre race next month?

lines.zh: 是啊，我每天早上跑十公里，周末跑二十公里，可能是练得太多了。
lines.en: Yes. I run 10 kilometres every morning and 20 at the weekend. Maybe I trained too much.

lines.zh: 医生怎么说？
lines.en: What did the doctor say?

lines.zh: 医生说问题不大，但是这两个星期最好别跑了，不然会越来越严重。
lines.en: The doctor said it is nothing serious, but I had better not run for the next two weeks, or it will get worse and worse.

lines.zh: 那比赛还能参加吗？
lines.en: So can you still take part in the race?

lines.zh: 我也不知道。如果休息两个星期，最后只剩十几天，肯定跑不出好成绩。
lines.en: I don't know. If I rest for two weeks, there will only be about ten days left, so I certainly won't get a good time.

lines.zh: 成绩不是最重要的，身体才是。这次就当是去试一试，能跑完就很好了。
lines.en: Your time is not what matters most; your health is. Treat this one as a try. Finishing would be great.

lines.zh: 你说得有道理，我不应该太着急。
lines.en: You have a point. I shouldn't be in such a hurry.

qs.en: What happened to the woman?
opts: 跑步的时候把脚弄伤了

qs.en: How long is the race?
How far does the woman run at the weekend?
What did the doctor tell the woman to do?
What does the man think matters most?

passages.title: A few words at the wedding
passages.scene: A woman has been asked to speak at her best friend's wedding.

lines.zh: 下个月我最好的朋友结婚，她让我在婚礼上说几句。
lines.en: My best friend is getting married next month, and she has asked me to say a few words at the wedding.

lines.zh: 这是好事啊，你怎么看起来不太高兴？
lines.en: That is a good thing. Why do you look so unhappy?

lines.zh: 我一站到很多人面前就紧张，不知道该说些什么。
lines.en: As soon as I stand in front of a lot of people I get nervous, and I don't know what to say.

lines.zh: 你们认识多少年了？
lines.en: How many years have you known each other?

lines.zh: 我们从小学就是同学，快二十年了。
lines.en: We have been classmates since primary school. It is nearly twenty years.

lines.zh: 那你肯定有很多故事可以讲，比如你们小时候一起做过的有意思的事。
lines.en: Then you must have lots of stories to tell, like fun things you did together when you were little.

lines.zh: 有道理。我记得有一次我们没告诉父母就去河边玩，回家以后都被批评了。
lines.en: True. I remember once we went to play by the river without telling our parents, and we both got told off when we got home.

lines.zh: 这个故事不错，大家听了一定会笑。最后再说几句祝福的话就行了。
lines.en: That is a good story. Everyone will laugh. Then just finish with a few good wishes.

lines.zh: 讲多长时间比较合适？
lines.en: How long should I speak for?

lines.zh: 三到五分钟就够了，太长了大家会着急吃饭的。
lines.en: Three to five minutes is enough. Any longer and people will be impatient to eat.

qs.zh: 她的朋友下个月要做什么？
qs.en: What is her friend doing next month?
Why is the woman not very happy?
opts: 不知道在婚礼上该说什么

qs.zh: 女的和朋友认识多少年了？
qs.en: How long have the woman and her friend known each other?
What does the man suggest she talk about?
opts: 小时候一起做过的有意思的事

qs.zh: 讲话多长时间比较合适？
qs.en: How long is a good length for the speech?
